intro: RHINO Regal delivers 100X* stronger protection than a standard wooden cupboard, with lockable internal compartments and robust steel bolts to secure what matters most. (*Refernece to strength as 100X stronger is based on controlled in-house tests.)

features.title: Advanced Precision Keylock
features.text: This keylock is designed with high-precision engineering to ensure smooth and accurate operation. It provides dependable, tamper-resistant security for enhanced protection.

features.title: Ultimate Security with 3 Way Solid Steel Shooting Bolts
features.text: Our locker is equipped with 3-way solid steel shooting bolts for enhanced protection. These heavy-duty bolts reinforce the safe door, ensuring your valuables are secured with maximum strength.

features.title: Mounting & Grouting
features.text: Designed for ultimate protection,this feature allows you to securely mount or grout the safe to walls, floors, or shelves using robust anchor bolts. By firmly fastening the locker in place, it becomes significantly more resistant to tampering or unauthorized removal, providing an extra layer of security.

features.title: Lockable Top Compartment
features.text: A dedicated lockable compartment offers enhanced privacy and organised storage for high-value items. It adds an additional layer of security, ensuring essential belongings remain protected yet readily accessible.

features.title: Adjustable Shelf for Versatile Storage
features.text: Maximize your Home Locker’s storage potential with our adjustable shelf, designed for flexible organization. Easily adjust the space to accommodate taller items, creating a customizable and organized environment that keeps your valuables neatly stored and easily accessible.

features.title: Sleek and Ergonomic Handle with Premium Interiors
features.text: The contemporary handle offers effortless operation and a refined look, complemented by premium interiors that ensure an elegant, well-organised, and functional storage experience

name: Rhino Regal Keylock Safe
